title: Comprehensible Japanese — Beginner: 日本の春 (Spring in Japan)
description: A beginner-level immersion video from Comprehensible Japanese. The narrator describes spring in Japan — cherry blossoms, school entrance ceremonies, and seasonal food — using clear, measured speech. Designed for learners transitioning from N5 to N4 with some new compound expressions.
